args.text: Seedlings, herbs and flowers grown by your neighbours

Join us at the Maple Court community garden for our annual plant sale. Every plant has been raised from seed in the greenhouse, and every penny goes back into the garden.
You will find tomato and pepper seedlings, a dozen kinds of herbs, sunflowers, sweet peas and bedding plants for pots and borders, all labelled with growing tips from the volunteers who raised them.
There will be tea and home-made cake, a children's planting table, and a free seed swap for anyone who brings a packet to share. Please bring your own bags and boxes, and come early for the best choice: the beans always go first.

Saturday 17 April
10 am to 3 pm
Free entry
Raffle tickets on sale at the gate, 1 dollar each
